bounds: Two keys in distinct fixed team/region namespaces, two contexts, two ciphertext slots, and two encryptions per key (abstract random-nonce ceiling).
limits: Atomic bounded successful events only; no AES proof, nonce probability, JSON/IAM parsing, SQLite crash refinement, host authentication, time or arbitrary key policies. Last event stores pre-operation conditions so later Disable does not invalidate an earlier legitimate output.
